{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''bodyguard''' escorted [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to safety<ref name="TFU guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> during her [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escape]] from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> an [[Unidentified male (Bail Organa)|associate]] of<ref name="RA">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> fellow senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] informed her that she was to be [[Prisoner/Legends|arrested]] for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU guide" /> Mothma escaped the planet minutes before the arrival of [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agents. She began travelling across [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to further the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel cause]]<ref name="RA" /> and, several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after her escape, signed the [[Corellian Treaty]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> forming the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bodyguard was was mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' published in [[2008]] as a supplement to the ''[[Saga Edition]]'' of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="TFU guide" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[escape from the Senate|escape]] from [[Coruscant]] was portrayed in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor]],<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> which debuted on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> In it, Mothma was escorted out of the [[Imperial Senate Building]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] agent [[Cassian Jeron Andor]], and then taken off-planet by [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
